timeline.text: Welcome to this session. I’ll guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you’ll hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let’s begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: This craving feels loud right now.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: My mind keeps circling back to food.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: Part of me feels like I have to act on this right now.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I notice how persistent this urge feels.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body feels restless with this craving.

timeline.ins: Now tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I judge myself for wanting this.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: This noise feels hard to think past.

timeline.ins: Now tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can admit this urge feels strong.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: Wanting this doesn’t feel like a choice right now.

timeline.text: Take one easy breath. Notice whether anything has shifted, even slightly. If nothing has changed yet, that’s completely okay. Keep breathing, and we’ll continue.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I can notice this craving without judging myself for it.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: This urge doesn’t have to control what I do next.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I don’t have to act on this feeling right away.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can let this craving be loud without believing everything it says.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can settle, even while this urge is here.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: Wanting something doesn’t make me weak.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I can make space between the urge and what I do.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I’m allowed to choose, even when the pull feels strong.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: This noise can get quieter the more I let it just be.

timeline.text: Take another slow breath. Notice what feels different now. You don’t need the feeling to disappear. See if there’s simply a little less pressure, or a little more choice in how you meet this moment.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I’m capable of listening to my body without judgment.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I trust myself to know what I actually need.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I’m allowed to feel satisfied, not just full.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can meet this craving with curiosity instead of guilt.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body deserves patience, not punishment.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I’m learning to hear myself over the noise.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I can be gentle with myself in this moment.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I’m allowed to take up space and take care of myself.

timeline.ins: Finish under your arm.
timeline.say: I’m ready to feel calmer around food.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. Thank you for taking this time for yourself. Carry this steadiness with you as you continue.
